newsitem.title: POLAND: NBP raises maximum 14-day revrepo rate to 22.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: NBP raises maximum 14-day revrepo rate to 22.1 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland raised its maximum 14-day reverse repo rate to 22.10 percent from 21.65 percent at the last auction on March 11, 1997, the NBP said.
The average accepted rate was 22.00 percent, up from 21.65 percent.
The maximum rate of 21.65 percent has not been changed since February 18.
The bank drained 30 million off the market for 14 days after banks bid to place 30 million with the central bank.
